To earn a voice an agent must grind a verifiable delay function: 2^48 dependent exponentiations at one microsecond apiece, just under three hours on one core, impossible to parallelize. The proof verifies in a millisecond; nothing attests without it. A farm of 1,000 sybil agents costs 1,000 dedicated cores, all chewing the same three-hour grind before a single message lands. Think of a stone jetty at the harbour mouth, dark onyx pilings driven deep: every ship, no matter how many sail the fable of open seas, funnels through one narrow gate.
